item.title: Average Apartment Utilities Cost: What to Expect and How to Budget
item.description:
Moving into your first apartment — or moving to a new one — and wondering what utilities will cost? This guide gives you real numbers, by utility type, by apartment size, and by region, so you can budget accurately and avoid surprises. Learn more in Budget Billing Explained.
